thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: private-vpc AcmeCorp - GPU queue growth detected 
incident-bot: metric: gpu_request_queue_length > 120 for 7m, autoscaler failed to add nodes for 5 consecutive attempts, recent error: "node-provision timeout"

oncall-nyc: ack. paging in SRE. tagging @sre-ella and @infra-raj

sre-ella: I'm on it. initial check: customer cluster has 2x reserved pools, both at 100% alloc. Autoscaler logs show repeated preflight failures (image pull + preflight checks timing out).

infra-raj: seeing same on control plane side. Provision requests sent, but instance bootstrap step never transitions to Ready. Kubelet logs show disk-pressure taints briefly, then initial containerd pull fails.

eng-runtime: FYI we recently rolled a preflight check change that reorders kernel modules load on the bootstrap image; could be related. Rolling back isn't trivial but we can force a fallback to the previous image for AcmeCorp pool.

cust-success-maya: AcmeCorp reports degraded inference for 2 of their services, retrying requests. They say tail latency spiked to 18s and some requests errored. Customer on the line, wants ETA.

oncall-nyc: Can we get quick mitigation: 1) stop large scaleups to this cluster to avoid saturating quota, 2) fallback to older bootstrap image, 3) open a temporary manual capacity pool?

eng-runtime: I'll prepare the image fallback. Need approval for a manual patch to the cluster config.

sre-ella: While you prep that, I'll open a manual node from our infra pool and bind it to the customer's NodePool with label "manual-fallback=true". That should drain some of the queued requests ASAP.

infra-raj: Note: account-level GPU quota for the region is 280 GPUs; current in-use is 272. Creating manual nodes will push us near limit. Suggest backfill via preemptible pool on a different region and route traffic with smart routing.

oncall-nyc: @deploy-bot can you run the quickprobe to confirm API endpoints and request lane health?

deploy-bot: run quickprobe --target acmecorp-vpc --checks=endpoint,queue,len

deploy-bot: quickprobe results:
```
endpoint: OK
queue_length: 128
avg_latency_1m: 14.2s
recent_errors: 6%  (502/504)
```

sre-ella: Confirmed. 128 queued, steady increase. Starting manual node provisioning now. I'll post kube events as I see them.

sre-ella: kubectl get events -n acmecorp | tail -n 8
```
2024-11-04T15:02:32Z Pod acme-req-xxxx FailedScheduling insufficient resources
2024-11-04T15:03:12Z Node bootstrap-abc ImagePullBackOff unable to pull image "org/runtime-bootstrap:v3"
2024-11-04T15:03:49Z Node bootstrap-abc KubeletNotReady kubelet stopped
2024-11-04T15:04:10Z CloudProvider ProvisionRequestFailed timeout waiting for instance ready
2024-11-04T15:05:01Z Node bootstrap-def ImagePullBackOff unable to pull image "org/runtime-bootstrap:v3"
2024-11-04T15:05:45Z Node bootstrap-def KubeletNotReady network config failed
```

eng-runtime: that ImagePullBackOff for v3 matches the preflight reorder issue. I'm switching the NodePool image to runtime-bootstrap:v2 for new nodes and kicking the autoscaler to retry. Will patch NodePool spec now.

eng-runtime: Patch command:
```
kubectl patch nodepool acmecorp-gpu --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/bootstrapImage","value":"org/runtime-bootstrap:v2"}]' -n acmecorp
```

infra-raj: I'm also reducing parallel provisioning threads to 4 to stop overwhelming the control plane (current was 10). That should reduce contention and allow image pulls to succeed.

sre-ella: Manual node created: node-manual-001 joined, labeled and schedulable. Beginning pod binding.

cust-success-maya: Customer says they can see request backpressure easing on their side (some jobs started completing). They still want a postmortem and ETA for full recovery.

oncall-nyc: Good. Continue monitoring. If queue < 40 and error < 1% we'll move to mitigated. Target 20m to steady-state.

eng-runtime: Autoscaler retried provisioning with v2 image - logs show success for two new nodes. Quote from autoscaler: "Provision succeeded: 2 nodes ready".

deploy-bot: quickprobe --target acmecorp-vpc --checks=queue,len,errors

deploy-bot: results:
```
queue_length: 42
avg_latency_1m: 3.8s
recent_errors: 0.8% (10/1200)
```

sre-ella: Nice. Queue down to 42. Keeping manual node for 15 more minutes, then we'll drain and scale down if stable.

infra-raj: Filed CR to bump regional GPU quota request + emergency support ticket with cloud provider for image registry flakiness. Ticket: CP-87321.

cust-success-maya: Logged customer impact and informed AcmeCorp: brief degraded service, mitigation applied, follow-up postmortem promised.

oncall-nyc: Handoff notes for next on-call: issue triggered by bootstrap image v3 causing repeated ImagePullBackOff and k8s KubeletNotReady, which blocked autoscaler scaling. Immediate mitigations: fallback to v2 image, reduce parallel provisioning threads, manual node from infra pool, and route traffic via different region preemptible pool if quotas hit. Action items: 1) eng-runtime to roll corrective patch for bootstrap ordering and test across images; 2) infra to pursue quota bump and registry reliability; 3) platform to add a graceful fallback in autoscaler when image pull errors exceed threshold.

sre-ella: marking this thread as INCIDENT-MITIGATED. Will draft postmortem and attach logs.

oncall-nyc: closing pager, handing to eng-runtime for root cause PR and to cust-success for customer comms. :thumbsup:
